description:
Team Cosmic Error 404: 
Passionate about space and clear, usable software, we are building an interactive tool that lets mission planners, educators and the public plan and select the most appropriate dates and lunar landing sites for lunar missions.

Challenge: 
Picking a lunar landing site is hard. Terrain shadows make polar sunlight shift constantly, yet landers need power, Earth line-of-sight and battery to survive darkness. NASA's data is too technical for most people to use.
